questions.question: What sign did God have Jeremiah perform with a linen loincloth in chapter 13?
options: Give it away to the poor, showing forth God's tender care for all the needy
Hide it by the Euphrates until it was ruined, showing how pride would be ruined
Wear it continually until it fell apart, showing the great weariness of the people
Burn it whole upon the altar, showing the people the coming day of judgment
questions.answer: Hide it by the Euphrates until it was ruined, showing how pride would be ruined

questions.question: What rhetorical question about change does Jeremiah 13 ask?
options: Can a leopard change its spots?
questions.answer: Can a leopard change its spots?
